```python
import simpa as sp
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set global simulation parameters
VOLUME_DIMENSIONS_MM = [40, 40, 10]  # x, y, z in mm
SPACING_MM = 0.5  # mm
WAVELENGTHS = [700, 750, 800, 850, 900]  # nm

# Simulation settings
settings = sp.Settings()
settings[sp.Tags.SIMULATION_PATH] = "./simpa_tissue_simulation"
settings[sp.Tags.VOLUME_NAME] = "tissue_volume"
settings[sp.Tags.WAVELENGTHS] = WAVELENGTHS
settings[sp.Tags.SPACING_MM] = SPACING_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_X_MM] = VOLUME_DIMENSIONS_MM[0]
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Y_MM] = VOLUME_DIMENSIONS_MM[1]
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Z_MM] = VOLUME_DIMENSIONS_MM[2]
settings[sp.Tags.STRUCTURE_DEFINITIONS] = "tissue_structure"
settings[sp.Tags.DEVICE] = sp.InVision256TF()
settings[sp.Tags.ILLUMINATION_TYPE] = sp.Tags.ILLUMINATION_TYPE_FOCUSED
settings[sp.Tags.OPTICAL_MODEL] = sp.Tags.OPTICAL_MODEL_MC
settings[sp.Tags.ACOUSTIC_MODEL] = sp.Tags.ACOUSTIC_MODEL_LINEAR
settings[sp.Tags.DO_FILE_COMPRESSION] = False

# Function to create the tissue structure
def create_tissue_structure():
    structures = []

    # Background (water)
    background = sp.define_background_structure_settings(
        molecular_composition=sp.MolecularCompositionGenerator().create_from_dict(
            sp.water()
        )
    )
    structures.append(background)

    # Muscle layer
    muscle_layer = sp.define_horizontal_layer_structure_settings(
        name="muscle",
        z_start_mm=2,
        thickness_mm=6,
        molecular_composition=sp.MolecularCompositionGenerator().create_from_dict(
            sp.get_muscle_reference_dictionary()
        )
    )
    structures.append(muscle_layer)

    # Epidermis layer
    epidermis_layer = sp.define_horizontal_layer_structure_settings(
        name="epidermis",
        z_start_mm=0,
        thickness_mm=0.2,
        molecular_composition=sp.MolecularCompositionGenerator().create_from_dict(
            sp.get_epidermis_reference_dictionary()
        )
    )
    structures.append(epidermis_layer)

    # Blood vessel 1
    vessel1 = sp.define_circular_tubular_structure_settings(
        name="blood_vessel_1",
        z_start_mm=4,
        radius_mm=1.0,
        center_x_mm=12,
        center_y_mm=20,
        molecular_composition=sp.MolecularCompositionGenerator().create_from_dict(
            sp.get_fully_oxygenated_blood_reference_dictionary()
        )
    )
    structures.append(vessel1)

    # Blood vessel 2
    vessel2 = sp.define_circular_tubular_structure_settings(
        name="blood_vessel_2",
        z_start_mm=6,
        radius_mm=1.5,
        center_x_mm=28,
        center_y_mm=20,
        molecular_composition=sp.MolecularCompositionGenerator().create_from_dict(
            sp.get_fully_deoxygenated_blood_reference_dictionary()
        )
    )
    structures.append(vessel2)

    return structures

# Add tissue structure to settings
settings.set_volume_creation_settings({
    sp.Tags.STRUCTURE_DEFINITIONS: create_tissue_structure()
})

# Run the simulation
sp.simulate(settings)

# Linear unmixing
unmixing_settings = sp.Settings(settings)
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.PROCESSING_PIPELINE] = [
    {
        "component": sp.LinearUnmixing,
        "settings": {
            "unmixing_method": "pseudo_inverse",
            "chromophores": ["oxyhemoglobin", "deoxyhemoglobin", "water", "melanin"]
        }
    }
]
sp.run(unmixing_settings)

# Load and visualize results
initial_pressure = sp.load_data_field(settings, sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD_INITIAL_PRESSURE)
unmixed = sp.load_data_field(unmixing_settings, sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD_UNMIXING_RESULT)

# Visualize initial pressure at 800 nm
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.title("Initial Pressure (800 nm)")
plt.imshow(initial_pressure[2, :, :, WAVELENGTHS.index(800)], cmap='hot')
plt.axis('off')

# Visualize oxyhemoglobin unmixed result
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.title("Oxyhemoglobin (Unmixed)")
plt.imshow(unmixed["oxyhemoglobin"][2, :, :], cmap='hot')
plt.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
